summary: 19 of 50 tests fail. Two root causes explain 18 of them: (1) src/lib/store/resource-store.ts captures process.env.DATA_DIR and file paths at module-load time as top-level constants — every store test and every route test that seeds via env-var isolation reads/writes the wrong (empty) path, cascading into 14 failures across store, /api/resources/:id, /api/resources/metrics, and /api/resources/:id/download. Fix on the coder side: resolve DATA_DIR inside each function. (2) src/components/__tests__/ResourceCard.test.tsx imports ResourceCard as default and spreads Resource fields as props, but the component is a named export taking a single `{ resource }` prop — this causes 3 component test failures plus a cascading tsc --noEmit failure. Fix on the tester side. The remaining failure is a real Prettier formatting violation across 9 mixed-owner files, resolvable by running `prettier --write`. No spec bugs; contract does not need to change.
